passages.context: Pages VII-IX identify the 1952 book as the sixth typical edition after 1614, describe Cum denuo as signed by the Sacred Congregation of Rites' pro-prefect on 25 January 1952, describe the book's twelve-title architecture, and identify title XII as De exorcizandis obsessis a Daemonio. These are the editors' statements about the anastatic source, not direct inspection of the complete 1952 book or decree.
